discards.claim: The driver's own GPS trace supports an in-geofence run of only 255 seconds: five consecutive qualifying fixes from 23:42:21 to 23:46:36, against the 480-second AIRPORT minimum POL-NS-01(c) sets — 225 seconds short. Even crediting him with the entire unobserved interval through to the 23:49:05 cancellation, the export's face-value reading is 404 seconds, still 76 seconds short, as the pre-pass notes. This artifact is impaired and I say so: weight 0.25, issue codes CLOCK_SKEW (228 s), GPS_GAP (186 s sitting across the moment of geofence entry), LOW_COVERAGE (22.8%), TRUNCATED_LOG (trace stops 149 s before the terminal event), LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD. The discount does not repair the shortfall — the 186-second gap that conceals the entry moment is precisely why entry cannot be credited earlier, and after 23:46:36 the trace shows no in-geofence fix at all.
discards.detail: the claim cites impaired artifact EV-TRIP-00210 at weight_multiplier 0.4 but does not name its issue code(s): CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT

discards.claim: The one route by which a short in-geofence run could be lengthened is closed on this record. EV-ADVIS-00210-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) — no advisory covers the Changi T1 arrival kerb in this window — and its absence is itself citable. POL-NS-06(i) requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated before separate in-geofence intervals may be summed, so the accumulated-dwell computation is unavailable and the driver's time stands at the 255 seconds the trace records. Nothing may be added to it.
discards.detail: the claim cites impaired artifact EV-GPS-00210 at weight_multiplier 0.25 but does not name its issue code(s): CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD

discards.claim: POL-NS-01(b) requires the trace to place the driver inside the pickup geofence defined in POL-NS-02 at or before the timestamp of the arrived event. On the export as it stands the first qualifying in-geofence fix is stamped 23:42:21 — eleven seconds AFTER the trip record's 23:42:10 arrival event — and the trace's device clock runs 228 seconds ahead of the server, far over the 90-second limb in POL-NS-08(a), so on the pre-pass's own finding no fix can be safely matched to the arrival event. An arrival marker whose position at the marker cannot be verified does not satisfy limb (b), and the artifact's impairment (weight 0.25) is disclosed.

ruling.explanation:
The dispute is the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee charged to the rider at Changi T1. The fee itself is in order: EV-FARE-00210 is COMPLETE at weight 1.0, the SGD 6.00 cancellation-fee line reconciles with the fee_schedule resolution rule (the greater of the AIRPORT zone-class fee of SGD 6.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee of SGD 4.00), so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged, and payment_status is PENDING with refund_issued_sgd of 0.00. But I cannot decide whether that fee stands or is refunded on this record, and I am sending the case to a human reviewer. The SGD 6.00 is held: not collected from the rider and not refunded.

The fee requires all four limbs of POL-NS-01. Two are satisfied on the trip record: there is a driver 'arrived' event at 23:42:10, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 23:49:05 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the codes limb (d) recognises. The other two limbs turn on the GPS trace, and that is where the case breaks down.

EV-GPS-00210 is impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08(a) and (b): its device clock runs 228 seconds ahead of the server (the limit is 90), and it loses a 186-second sampling gap from 23:39:15 to 23:42:21 that sits exactly across the moment of geofence entry. Its weight is 0.25 and its issue codes are CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD. Read at face value the first qualifying in-geofence fix is 23:42:21 and the dwell to the 23:49:05 cancellation is 404 seconds, 76 seconds short of the 480-second AIRPORT minimum POL-NS-01(c) requires. Corrected for the 228-second skew the same fix falls at 23:38:33 server time and the dwell is 632 seconds, comfortably over. The gap conceals the one fact that would choose between them, so limb (c) is undecided and limb (b) cannot be verified either, because no fix can be safely matched to the 23:42:10 arrival event.

The trip record EV-TRIP-00210 is also impaired, at weight 0.4 with issue code CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT: its arrived_at of 23:42:10 and its implied 6.9-minute (415-second) wait cannot be reconciled with the trace. Two admitted artifacts therefore contradict each other directly on arrival and dwell, and no clause resolves the conflict.

On the parties' competing claims: the rider's case that the 6.9-minute window (415 seconds, from the arrival tap to cancellation) falls 65 seconds short reads the tap, but POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and once the skew is allowed for the same trace yields 632 seconds, so the shortfall is not proved. The driver's case that the corrected 632 seconds puts him over the minimum is equally unprovable, because the 186-second gap hides the entry moment. The accumulated-dwell route under POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable: EV-ADVIS-00210-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0, and the limb requires a present, populated advisory. On POL-NS-02 the driver's closest approach of 96 m is inside the 150 m AIRPORT radius with 5 qualifying fixes, so proximity is met on the face of the trace, but that only turns the dispute to dwell, which is undecided.

The driver's compensation claim under POL-NS-07 (SGD 4.80, being 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee) fails because POL-NS-07 requires POL-NS-01 satisfied in full, which it is not. The anti-farming check does not trip - no_show_terminations_30d of 2 is below 4 and 2/156 = 0.013 is below 0.08 - so no abuse finding and no packet from that branch. On the rider's exoneration routes: POL-NS-04 does not apply, because the only surviving rider message ('why cancel?? i was at door 6') was sent at 23:49:40, after the 23:49:05 cancellation, so limb (a) fails, and limb (c) is undecidable because the trace carries no rider_track (PARTIAL_RECORD), which is neutral rather than adverse. POL-NS-05 cannot be run at all while the 228-second skew makes the arrival marker unmatchable, so no false-arrival finding is entered. POL-NS-03 is not engaged, the driver's fixes sitting inside the 150 m radius.

Confidence is capped at 0.25, the weight of the sole artifact (the GPS trace) that carries the dwell under POL-NS-01(c), far below the 0.70 floor. Escalation is triggered three ways: POL-NS-09(b) (two admitted artifacts contradict on arrival and dwell, unresolved by any clause), POL-NS-09(e) (the sole evidence for the deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) and (b)), and POL-NS-09(a) (confidence below the floor). No referral is issued: POL-NS-05(ii) cannot fire because the clause cannot be run, and POL-NS-07's anti-farming branch has not tripped. The open question for the reviewer is when the driver actually entered the geofence - whether the 228-second device skew should be corrected (632 seconds, fee chargeable) or not (404 seconds, fee refundable) - and whether the 186-second gap conceals an entry before 23:42:10.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
